arange_note: numpy computes arange as start + i*step, not as a running sum; the two diverge once step is inexact in binary. The lattice is built from this, so the Rust port reproduces the multiply form. Recorded directly because the resulting ULP differences seldom move a sample across a cell boundary, and so would not be caught by cell parity alone.
note: Cell hits with multiplicity, in accumulation order, from each of Python's two circular-footprint rasterizations. The two disagree whenever radius/resolution is not an integer; see docs/migration/FOOTPRINT_RASTERIZATION.md. Floats cross as strings so the sub-cell phase survives parsing exactly.
